summary: Applied T4 review fixes for UUID route identity, safe task loading, capability controls, mutation reconciliation, live task creation, backlog paging, member/checkpoint states, and mutation error recovery.

produces.note: Live task loading/filter/paging and prototype fallback.

produces.note: Live epics/tasks with no sprint controls.

produces.name: Task live flow
produces.note: Live task read/update/status with version and no live delete.

behavior: TaskCard, backlog links, and task drawer navigation preserve the active UUID; the drawer rejects tasks whose projectId does not match the route.
Live task creation starts empty and accepts only an ID from the loaded live epic collection; live screens do not render sprint controls or send sprintId.
Task loading failures use safe retryable messages distinct from not-found; PMs are read-only, Dev Leads may mutate, and Developers may mutate only their own assigned task.
Board mutations refetch the active filter/page, drawer mutations notify the board, and live Mark blocked updates the selected task with its version.

Task load 404s and project mismatches share the normal missing-task state; stale drawer responses are ignored; conflicts and mutation errors stay visible with explicit reload while the drawer remains open.
Live board, backlog, checkpoint, and member errors expose safe retry controls; checkpoint loading is generation-guarded with meaningful empty state; backlog paging avoids false empty epics.

Focused coverage verifies checkpoint create/loading, conflict and 422 form persistence, failed mutations without phantom rows or auto-retry, retry/error behavior, filters, pagination reset, visible member dedupe, and no sprintId.
next: T5 runs route/API regressions, full frontend verification, and manual UUID route checks.
manual_route_checks: Open a live UUID board/backlog/checkpoints/members/task route in the browser and verify loading, safe error, success refresh, and pagination states against a running backend.
Verify backend role and tenancy responses remain authoritative for live reads and writes.
for_t5: Route and API regressions should cover the live page adapter paths, no-sprintId request shapes, and the manual UUID route checks above.
